basic_details.job_title: CSIR-IMTECH Project Technical Support II Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: One Project Technical Support-II (PTS-II) position is open at the CSIR-Institute of Microbial Technology (सीएसआईआर-सूक्ष्मजीव प्रौद्योगिकी संस्थान), Chandigarh, under the project "Development and validation of novel Candida Leucine aminopeptidase 2 based immunoassay for the diagnosis and prognosis of invasive candidiasis among patients with cirrhosis (GAP-0256)". The post pays Rs. 20,000/- + HRA a month, needs 12th in Science with a Diploma and five years' experience or a three-year graduate degree with two years' experience, and has an upper age limit of 30 years. It is advertised under Rolli

age_limit.details: The upper age limit is 30 years. The notice does not mention a cut-off date for counting age or any age relaxation.

qualification.details: Candidates need either of the following two combinations: | 12th in Science + Diploma (MLT/ DMLT / Engineering or equivalent) + Five years experience in relevant subject / field OR Three-year graduate degree in relevant subject/field + Two years experience in relevant field | The five years' experience applies to the 12th plus Diploma route, and the two years' experience applies to the three-year graduate degree route.

content_sections.heading: CSIR-IMTECH Project Technical Support-II (PTS-II) at a Glance
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the last date, the application fee or the selection process, and it does not state how or where to apply.

rows.details: Development and validation of novel Candida Leucine aminopeptidase 2 based immunoassay for the diagnosis and prognosis of invasive candidiasis among patients with cirrhosis (GAP-0256)

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates need either of the following two combinations: 12th in Science + Diploma (MLT/ DMLT / Engineering or equivalent) + Five years experience in relevant subject / field OR Three-year graduate degree in relevant subject/field + Two years experience in relevant field The five years' experience applies to the 12th plus Diploma route, and the two years' experience applies to the three-year graduate degree route. Experience in protein expression from yeast, E. coli, or mammalian cells. Experience in microbiome analysis is also desirable. The upper age limit is 30 years. The notice does not mention a cut-off date for counting age or any age relaxation. Result awaited candidates are not eligible to apply. Candidates should check the official notification for the exact subject or field that counts as relevant for this post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The monthly emoluments are Rs. 20,000/- + HRA, so HRA is paid in addition to the Rs. 20,000. The rate of HRA is not specified in the notice. The post is a project position under GAP-0256; the notice does not mention its tenure.
